summary.oneLiner: Secunderabad-based manufacturer and trader of adhesive tapes, die-cuts, polishing compounds, buffing pads and car care products for the automotive OEM and auto refinish markets.
summary.business: Sumax Engineering Limited manufactures adhesive tapes and die-cuts, pre-taped masking film, rubbing and polishing compounds, buffing and foam pads, reflective tapes, domes and graphics and car care products, and additionally trades electrical and pneumatic tools, abrasive sheets/discs/rolls, body shop consumables, retail products and accessories and aerosol products.
